Nuno Felix RT @TheEuropeansHQ : 🇸🇪 🇳🇴 🇫🇮 🇱🇹 🇳🇱 🇪🇺 One of the largest defence contracts in Swedish history. Five European countries came together to place a joint order worth approximately €5.5 billion to procure over 400 CV90 infantry fighting vehicles. Battle-proven in Ukraine, the Swedish-built CV90 will incorporate new anti-drone protection. Joint procurement, greater interoperability, economies of scale and investment in Europe's own industrial base: that's the way to go! Över 400 Stridsfordon 90 för drygt 60 miljarder kronor. En av de största ordrarna till svensk försvarsindustri någonsin. Idag signerades kontrakten för Sveriges, Norges, Finlands, Litauens och Nederländernas gemensamma inköp. Sverige köper 60 vagnar. I det allvarliga säkerhetsläget stärker vi våra länders försvar och gör Nato starkare. Jag vill tacka alla medarbetare på Hägglunds i Örnsköldsvik som utvecklat ett världsledande stridsfordon. CV90 har visat sin förmåga i Ukraina och fortsätter att utvecklas, bland annat med drönarskydd på de nya vagnarna. Ordern visar svensk försvarsindustris innovationskraft. Det ska vi vara stolta över. - Ulf Kristersson tweet

📊 The National Institute of Statistics (INE) confirmed that during the August–October quarter, the unemployment rate returned to double digits for the first time since the pandemic began in 2021, rising 1.6 percentage points year-over-year as employment fell and the unemployed population grew by nearly 20%. 👩 The deterioration has hit women hardest, with their unemployment rate climbing to 10.7% compared to 9.4% for men, while in the Metropolitan Region the rate reached 10.5%. 🏭 Likewise, the number of formal wage earners declined (-2.6%), driven by sharp drops in the communications sector (-18.9%) and manufacturing (-4.7%), pushing informal employment up to 27%.
